notes.title: Demo update and TPS Festival!
notes.notes:
Hello Wanderers,
The veil stirs once more.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458653/97b8586cda70871623da9418bb581dda866388ce.gif"]
A new and better DEMO is now available, with huge changes. We heard your feedbacks and heavly changed how Vespera Bononia plays and feels.
You may find:


 A completely revisited combat system

 A new character

 Angrier and smarter enemies

 More immersive and dark environment 
Play Vespera Bononia Demo now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2843680/

Steam Third Person Shooter Festival
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458653/3bd7b6dcc8dbf667cae983995799b5a6bcc71b84.gif"]
From August 25th to September 1st, we join the Steam Third Person Shooter Festival,  within this fleeting span, the streets of our cursed city will once again open to all who dare set foot in its shadowed halls.


Changelog
Want to go in-depth and know what we changed?

Updates
 Reworked enemy projectiles and characters for improved aesthetics regarding colour coding

 Added enemy’s special projectile

 Added new playable character, **Noah the Mesmerist**

 Added new movement type for playable characters

Added new **Status Effect** system

Added *two new enemies*: **Twilight Devotee** and **Blemmae**

 Added skills to switch between characters

 Changed light and aesthetics of sky in the first open map

 Headed Villosus: Increased healt for Boss

 Headed Villosus: Added turn in place animation

 Headed Villosus: Improved head’s laser behaviour

 Headed Villosus: Reworked ground impact Vfx

 Added buff, spawn and damage sound effects for Boss The Fearsome Beakla0w

 Improved the idol's red aura

 Improved wall and floor materials of the first open map

 Added new character’s footsteps sounds

 Added new visual effect for Dracchis' poison cloud attack

 Reworked material for Palelegs

 Added footsteps sound for different materials

 Changed color code for player’s projectile, different for each character

 Added air sound when player is falling

 Added UI wheel for character’s change with controller

 Added new Parry system

 Added new HUD UI

 Reworked enemy spawn system, now they spawn in waves

 Added animation when the player is dashing in the air

 Added new Vfx when switching character

 Now Rumble is applied to the Joystick for damage received  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458653/2a23691b9308c327049800553d70c2bac7a6abc3.gif"] 
BugfixesHeaded Villosus
 Delayed the pound ground attack from Villosus

 Head limits the "bounciness" when thrown against player

 Now clone’s head turrets turn the crosshair red when aimed at

 Synchronise sounds with actions

 Fixed head not returning to villosus if destroied after falling from the map

 Villosus ground hit won't hit enemies anymore

 Increased spawn distance between clone heads

 Fixed clone heads not checking allready spawned heads positions
Other fixes
 Fixed the behaviour of boss The Fearsome Beakclaw

 Corrected sounds volume

 Small lighting fixes  in the first open map

 Reduced the texture resolution of some assets for better performance

 Adjusted the idol's aura so that it is not visible between the camera and the character

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.notes:
🌑 Patch Notes — Echoes of the Villosus 🌒

Wanderers,
A tremor has rippled through the fabric of the dream. The city stirs, reshapes, and deepens. Shadows shift anew.

Today we unveil a new update for the demo — one that brings not just balance and clarity, but fresh dread.

Read below to discover what now walks the broken stones of Bononia.
🕯️ New Content and Enhancements


Added new Boss, The Headed Villosus
Changed jump attack behaviour and animation for Dracchis
Added new teleporting sound to The Fearsom Beaklaw
Fixed issues where Beacklaw would not rotate correctly towards player while doing an attack
Modified enemy navigation’s behaviour
Fixed UI of enemy’s health bar and chest bar for better visual clarity
Added option for inverted Y axis
Added light hint on the tutorial’s pressure platform to get back on the lift
Added areas in the map where shadows spawn as the player approaches
Added fractures in map porches to improve aesthetics
Fixed directional light color and intensity
Added visual effect of healing when the character heals
Lightburst skill now lasts less


🐛 Bugfixes from the Depths


Badges now behave correctly in the UI and will no longer overwrite one another.
Rebirth no longer causes incorrect post-process effects around the lower waist.
The crosshair now turns red even when facing shadows.
Resolved an issue where sound would disappear after restarting the level.
Idol of Fear’s lasers are no longer blocked by projectile collisions.


📜 Share Your Findings

Your descent into Vespera Bononia helps shape the abyss itself. Let us know how this update affects your journey — from new horrors to cleaner strikes.

Join the discussion here:
Steam Community Discussions

And if you've yet to brave the demo:
🕯️ Download the Demo Now

— The Devs of Vespera Bononia
